ai ad creator, ai video, ugc video, saas, nextjs, ad generator, brand kit, social media, advertising, stripe, typescript, postgresql, campaign manager, ai marketing, multi tenant

Adcraft 1.0.0 — Next.js 15 / React 19 / TypeScript SaaS. Node.js 22+, pnpm 9.15.9. Buyer ZIP contains source, lockfile, SQL migrations, HTML setup guide and third-party notices. No dist/docs/scripts folders, seller keys, database, dependencies or generated photographic demo media are included. Public documentation: https://pub-a73652c6060b4478b32ea08526a6a3ff.r2.dev/codecanyon/adcraft-v5-20261017/index.html

Local review: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; copy .env.example to .env; set a random AUTH_SECRET; leave DATABASE_URL blank; set ADMIN_EMAILS to your test email for admin access; run pnpm --filter @adcraft/app dev. Development sign-in accepts your test email. Create a workspace and brand. Text concepts have labelled offline samples. Static image generation and live HeyGen catalog/voice features require the matching provider key. Sandbox ad accounts let you test campaigns without paid ad spend. Production sign-in requires Resend or Google.

Catalog snapshot checked on 17 October 2026: 1,414 public presenter groups / 25,070 looks and 2,643 voices. Looks are not unique people. Provider accounts and usage credits are not included. Preview panels are purpose-made feature illustrations with sample content. Generated photos/videos are preview-only; the buyer site uses editable SVG placeholders. No real product brands or savings offer are used in the listing artwork.

Fresh install, production build, 8 package type checks, PostgreSQL and PGlite migrations, 9 automated tests, 21 static renders and 6 browser smoke tests passed. Live paid generation, payments, email and ad spend were not exercised. Docker could not be run on the validation host; native Node production startup was tested. Product-video rendering uses Remotion under its own licensing terms; see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. No public app demo is supplied; full local setup instructions are provided.
